24.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter “tuktu” to assure the hardened hunter you are not an enemy.

25.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter “tuktu” to assure the hapless hunter you are not an enemy.

48.original: A moment, if you would. I am recently returned from patrol, but I fear something has happened to my comrades. By all rights they should have arrived here when I did, if not sooner.

49.original: It was meant to be a simple sweep of the perimeter, dispensing with any raptors we spotted along the way.

50.original: Would you be willing to search for them? In case they should return before you do, I will remain here to receive them.

51.original: Hmmm. If they are wounded or hiding, they are not like to reveal themselves to a stranger. You will need our password─tuktu. But say the word and they will immediately know you for an ally of Slitherbough.

52.original: If you find them, do not forget to speak the password─tuktu.

54.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “tuktu” and allay the hunter's fears.

56.original: Ah, thank goodness. When I heard you approaching, I feared the worst.

57.original: I spotted a raptor not far from here and thought it a suitable opportunity to train my companion, a hunter newly joined to the guard. Yet in my fervor for the hunt, I somehow lost track of him.

58.original: The raptor is injured, but to leave it now would jeopardize our stores of food, or worse should anyone else cross its path. I must go after it.

59.original: Would you search for him in my stead? Once you have found him, return to Slitherbough and inform Maril that I've spotted a raptor and gave chase.

61.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “tuktu” and allay the hunter's fears.

64.original: We were hunting raptors, and managed to corner a rather nasty one. Or so we thought. After taking an arrow to the backside, it let out the most bloodcurdling scream. I was expecting it, but I panicked and ran all the same.

65.original: I think my nerves are settled now, though. I expect I'll get an earful from Maril, but I suppose I have it coming.

66.original: There you are. My comrades returned not long ago.

67.original: Though I was disappointed to hear our newest guardsman fled in the face of danger.

69.original: Perhaps he's not fit to protect Slitherbough.

70.original: Perhaps he needs more training before venturing out into the woods.

71.original: Perhaps you are right, but I must give this some thought before I speak with him. Thank you again for your help, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.
